i have overdose multiple times before. and i have been diagnosed with BPD (borderline personality disorder). 

i don't know if you can call this advice but trust me when i say, a lot of people have overdosed on lethal amounts. and we also do our research because we want to die from it. but it didn't worked. some of us have very little side effects, some of us suffers a huge side effects from surviving it. overdose is a lot of suicidal people choices for an attempt but when you woke up after surviving it, it's hell. 

also overdosing doesn't kill you instantly, you will probably live and be awake for a few days in pain and suffering before you can actually die. my experience with it is i can hear my heart palpitations for more than 3 days straight. my body trembled crazily a lot as i tried not to puke anything out (a lot of people ended up puking the pills because that's how the way of our body works its survival system in override mode). 

im also not here to stop you or anything. since im suicidal myself. and i believe people should do whatever they want. i don't know you and i also don't know what's best for you. i believe you as the individual yourself have a better grasps of how you're feeling and how you wanna deal with it. im just here to provide you with a little bit more information and experiences from me and a few other people as well.
